descriptions.trackingSources: Manage ingestion channels for tracking events (websites, server-side, chat, mobile).
descriptions.trackingEventTypes: Define the per-tenant dictionary of event codes the ingestion endpoint will accept.
descriptions.trackingLinks: Create trackable short links that record a click event and redirect to a target URL. WhatsApp targets (wa.me) also attribute the resulting conversation to the click.
descriptions.trackingEvents: Audit raw tracking events received from clients and downstream stitching outcomes.
